channel.description: Latest articles from Ocean News & Technology Magazine (oceannews.com)

item.title: AF Offshore Decom Announces New Decommissioning Project
item.description: AF Offshore Decom has signed a contract with Ithaca Energy for the engineering, receipt, cleaning, dismantling, and recycling of a floating storage unit (FSU) from the UK sector of the North Sea. The vessel has a total weight of approximately 24,000 metric tons and will be received at AF Environmental Base Vats (AFEBV) in 2026.

item.title: BOEM Shares Potential Critical Minerals Sales and Bidder Qualifications
item.description: The Bureau of Ocean Energy Management is preparing for the potential to hold competitive lease sales that will allow winning bidders to submit plans for future exploration and development of critical seabed minerals on the Outer Continental Shelf. These minerals are essential for advanced manufacturing, energy and defense technologies, and strengthening US supply chains. item.title: Martens en Van Oord Invests in USV from Demcon unmanned systems
item.description: Martens en Van Oord, a leading contractor in roadworks, civil and hydraulic engineering since 1986, is taking an important step toward further sustainability and modernization of its fleet. The company is investing in the latest generation of the V4000 autonomous unmanned survey vessel (USV) from Demcon unmanned systems, a specialist in high tech autonomous vessels for hydrographic and maritime applications. item.title: Results Show Main Cause of Ballast Water Treatment Compliance Detentions
item.description: Results from last year’s Concentrated Inspection Campaign (CIC) on ballast water management has revealed a marked change in regulatory compliance failures, which now include the actual performance, operation, and maintenance of installed ballast water treatment systems.

item.title: ABL Awarded Offshore Gig at Egypt’s Kamose Field
item.description: Energy and marine consultancy ABL has been appointed to provide marine warranty survey services to support the offshore construction for the Phase 4 development of the Kamose offshore gas field development in the Mediterranean Sea for North Sinai Petroleum Company (NOSPCO).

item.title: Drydocks World Joins the Maritime Emissions Reduction Centre as Newest International Member
item.description: The Maritime Emissions Reduction Centre (MERC) has welcomed Drydocks World, a DP World company, as its latest Centre member, strengthening the consortium’s technical depth and expanding its global network.

item.title: Eco Wave Power Reports Continued Strong Wave Energy Production at Jaffa Port
item.description: Eco Wave Power Global, a global leader in onshore wave energy technology, has provided an update on wave energy production at its EWP-EDF One wave energy pilot project at Jaffa Port, Israel, during January 2026.

item.title: Greenroom Robotics Completes AI Trial to Safeguard the Ocean
item.description: An Australian-made technology capable of autonomously detecting marine life and ocean hazards has completed a successful trial in one of the country's most sensitive marine environments in a major step for ocean safety and environmental protection.

item.title: Aker Solutions Awarded Long-Term MMO Frame Agreement by Aker BP
item.description: Aker Solutions has been awarded a major five-year contract with Aker BP for Maintenance, Modification and Operation services (MMO). The contract covers all Aker BP’s key assets on the Norwegian Continental Shelf, including the new Yggdrasil area.

item.title: GLDD Awards Zupt Contract for Survey Systems Integration on SRIV Acadia
item.description: Great Lakes Dredge & Dock Company (GLDD), the largest provider of dredging services in the United States, has awarded Zupt a contract to provide survey systems documentation, installation services, and commissioning activities aboard the SRIV Acadia. The vessel is currently under construction at Philly Shipyard for GLDD's Offshore Energy division.
